caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing upright against a plain, light-colored background. The figure has long, black hair and a light-skinned face with pink cheeks and red lips. She is dressed in a light-colored, off-the-shoulder dress with short puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice decorated with small, blue dots. Beneath the skirt, she wears matching light-colored pantalettes featuring a similar dotted pattern. Her arms and hands are painted in a muted green tone. She wears black shoes and there is no detailed background or surrounding objects. The bottom right corner of the image contains a handwritten signature that reads “Res Bush.”
title: Doll - "Martha"
